import React from "react"; import { DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuTrigger, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuItem, } from "@/components/ui/dropdown-menu"; import { Mail, MessageSquare, ChevronDown, Plus, Calendar, DollarSign, FileText, ClipboardCheck, ListChecks, Users, Link2 } from "lucide-react"; import { Button } from "@/components/ui-kit"; import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom"; /** * Top-right Send ▼ + + Create ▼ dropdowns on the Customer detail page. * Feb-2026 Customer Detail Additions ship. * * All items pre-fill the target flow with the current customer via a * ``?customer_id=`` query param — every existing create route already * respects this convention, so no receiving-side changes are required. */ export function CustomerActionDropdowns({ customer, onSend, onQuickTask, onSendServiceRecordsLink }) { const navigate = useNavigate(); const cid = customer?.id; const primaryEmail = (customer?.emails || []).find((e) => e.is_primary)?.address || customer?.email || ""; const primaryMobile = (customer?.mobiles || []).find((m) => m.is_primary)?.number_e164 || customer?.phone || ""; return (
{/* Send ▼ */} onSend?.({ channel: "email", to: primaryEmail })} data-testid="customer-send-email" > Email onSend?.({ channel: "sms", to: primaryMobile })} data-testid="customer-send-sms" > Text (SMS) {/* Task 6 · Feb 2026 — Send service records link. Opens a dedicated modal that dispatches a signed portal auto-login URL to the customer via Email or SMS. */} onSendServiceRecordsLink?.()} data-testid="customer-send-service-records-link" > Service records link {/* + Create ▼ */} navigate(`/jobs/new?customer_id=${cid}`)} data-testid="customer-create-visit" > Visit navigate(`/payments/new?customer_id=${cid}`)} data-testid="customer-create-payment" > Payment navigate(`/quotes/new?customer_id=${cid}`)} data-testid="customer-create-estimate" > Estimate → Quote Creates a quote you can send, sign, and collect on. navigate(`/invoices/new?customer_id=${cid}`)} data-testid="customer-create-invoice" > Invoice onQuickTask?.()} data-testid="customer-create-todo" > To-Do navigate(`/jobs/new?customer_id=${cid}&visit_type=meeting`) } data-testid="customer-create-meeting" > Meeting
); } export default CustomerActionDropdowns;
